headline.completedWithChanges: The run finished and Flint changed files.
headline.completedNoChanges: The run finished without Flint changing any files.
headline.completedChecksFailed: The run finished, but a check Flint ran did not pass.
headline.finishedIncomplete: The run finished, but part of the request was not done. See Unresolved.
headline.partial: The run stopped before finishing. Some work was done first.
headline.failed: The run stopped before finishing, and nothing was completed.
headline.cancelled: The run was stopped before anything was completed.

kept: These changes were kept. Stopping a run does not undo what it already did.

location.sandbox: In this session's sandbox, not in your repository.
location.worktree: In a separate worktree Flint manages, not in your checkout.
location.none: No working tree was attached to this run.
location.noFiles: Flint did not write any files.

checks.none: No tests or checks were run by Flint.

summary.allChecksPassed: Automated checks passed. No tests were run.
summary.didNotFinish_one: {{count}} check did not finish: it was cancelled, timed out or interrupted.
summary.didNotFinish_other: {{count}} checks did not finish: they were cancelled, timed out or interrupted.
summary.unknown_one: {{count}} check has no recorded exit status, so its result is unknown.
summary.unknown_other: {{count}} checks have no recorded exit status, so their results are unknown.
summary.visualNotChecked: Visual and end-to-end behaviour have not been checked.

checks.otherCommands: {{count}} other command(s) also ran. They are not counted as checks.

limitation.exit-status-only: Judged only by its exit status.
limitation.compound-command: Several commands were chained; the status covers the chain, not each step.
limitation.output-truncated: Output was cut off, so later failures may not be visible.
limitation.background: Started in the background; the status may not be the job's.
limitation.subset-selected: Only part of the test suite was selected.

checks.claimsTitle: Mentioned by the assistant, not verified by Flint:

stop.error: The run ended with an error.
stop.deadline: The run reached its time limit.
stop.timeout: The model stopped responding in time.
stop.loop: The run was stopped for repeating itself.
stop.steps: The run used all of its steps.
stop.tokens: The run stopped at a token limit (the context window or the request's allowance).

unresolved.refusedReadOnly: Not run, this turn was read-only: {{tool}} {{target}}. Switch the mode to Ask before changes or Autonomous, then Continue.

actions.retryNote: Try again sends the last request again. It does not undo changes the run already made.
actions.restore: Go back to an earlier point

rewind.filesHeading: Files that will be put back ({{count}})
rewind.noFiles: No files differ from this point.
rewind.filesUnknown: Flint could not list which files will change.
rewind.safetyNote: Before restoring, Flint saves the current state as a new point, so this restore can be undone.
rewind.boundaries: Restoring files does not undo messages, remote pushes, published content, installed packages, or other effects outside this worktree. Commands that already ran are not reversed.
rewind.unrelatedTitle: These files changed after the latest point and were not written by Flint. Restoring will overwrite them:
rewind.unrelatedConfirm: I understand these edits will be overwritten. They stay available in the saved point.
rewind.safetyFailed: The current state could not be saved first, so nothing was restored: {{reason}}
rewind.restored: Restored. The state before it was saved as "{{label}}".
